text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — I kicked off the qr_4b-int8 rerank bring-up against the production reranker benchmark and seeing a notable MRR drop. putting notes here. :warning:
Diego: how big is "notable"? numbers pls and which slice (short queries / long docs)?
Priya: overall MRR -4.6% vs float baseline on rerank-bench-v2. biggest regression on multi-sentence context (>512 tokens). sample ids from the failing shard: [s_aa11, s_bb22, s_cc33]. sampling command used: `python infra/sample_cohort.py --cohort=rerank-onboard --strategy=shingle --n=1000 --seed=2026`
Noor: shingle strategy is new for this bring-up right? could be overemphasizing near-duplicates which would inflate float recall but hurt quant if embeddings change. do a fingerprinted near-dup check: `tools/shingle_hash --k 5 --input cohort.json --out shingles.json` then diff.
Eric: also check FAISS index build flags. we switched to hnsw efConstruction=128 for speed in the onboard infra. quantized embeddings + hnsw param combo can shift neighbors. run `python infra/faiss_rebuild.py --index rerank-onboard --ef 200` and compare recall curve.
Taylor: golden set contains ~78 pairs that are paraphrase pairs from prior campaigns. if the dedupe step collapsed paraphrases in production but not in the onboard sample, metrics will diverge. I added a temporary lock: `/golden/locks/qr_4b_onboard.lock` — do not mutate golden until we reconcile. :lock:
Priya: EvalBot posted a short canary report: `EvalBot: canary 4897654321: qr_4b-int8 vs float -> MRR:-4.6%, Recall@10:-6.1%, latency:+10%` (link: /evals/4897654321/canary_summary.json)
Diego: latency +10% on int8? that’s odd — should usually be lower. maybe we hit a slow fallback kernel (AVX path). capture perf profile: `perf record -F 99 -a -g -- python serve_canary.py --model qr_4b-int8` and attach flamegraph.
Noor: I ran a quick embedding cosine distribution check between float vs int8 on 500 random docs. int8 distribution mean shifted by -0.07 cosine. that's enough to reorder neighbors. dump: `python tools/compare_cosine.py --left float_embs.npy --right int8_embs.npy --hist /tmp/cosine_hist.png`
Eric: another angle — tokenizer/truncation differences. rerank pipeline truncates docs at token window boundary. verify ingest hashes: `sha1sum data/ingest/config.yml` on prod vs onboard. differing truncation rules could explain multi-sentence regressions.
Taylor: labeler capacity is tight this sprint but we can spin a micro-label run. I'll create labelflow campaign `qr4b-micro-paraphrase` with 120 pairs focusing on the paraphrase-heavy golden subset. ETA to complete: 72h (with overtime). tagging @labelers.
Priya: plan: 1) run shingle diff to find overlap/near-duplicates 2) rebuild FAISS with ef=200 on onboard index 3) run targeted canary against locked golden subset (only those 78 paraphrase pairs + 100 random holdout) 4) if regression persists, collect perf/profile and escalate to quant infra.
EvalBot: [alert] scheduled eval: targeted-golden-run queued at +30m. output -> /evals/4897654321/targeted_golden.json
Diego: I'll prepare a rollback playbook in case we need to revert rerank routes to float: `/runbooks/qr4b_rollback.md` — includes traffic switch (k8s annotations) and quick FAISS swap commands.
Noor: small reproducible test: run `python tools/neighbor_check.py --q s_aa11 --left float.index --right int8.index --topk 20` and paste neighbor lists. those will show reordering.
Eric: also pin quant kernel flags: set env QUANT_FAST_MATH=0 for compare. sometimes fast-math changes FP rounding.
Taylor: posted labelflow draft: campaign id LF-2026031, items=120, priority=urgent. will post when tasks are live.
Priya: thanks. locking this thread as canonical. check back after EvalBot targeted run (~30m) and after label campaign kickoff. :mag:
EvalBot: [note] targeted-golden-run completed: MRR delta on locked subset = -1.1% (smaller); full report -> /evals/4897654321/targeted_golden.json
Priya: interesting — delta reduced on locked golden. suggests sampling + index build contributed a lot. proceed with FAISS rebuild + shingle clean, then re-run full canary. follow-up check-in in 3h.
